list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Switch from JDBC to JPA and implement entity classes
- Replaced JDBC-based data access with JPA-based persistence. - Created a base entity class `BaseEntity` with common attributes (e.g., id, version). - Defined specific entity classes (e.g., `User`, `Post`) extending `BaseEntity`. - Updated repository interfaces to use JPA repositories instead of JDBC. - Adjusted application configuration to support JPA and Hibernate. - Added entity mappings and annotations to manage relationships and constraints.
This change improves the maintainability and scalability of the data access layer by leveraging JPA and Hibernate.
